Google.name: Gemini 3.5 Flash
Google.description: Flagship multimodal model (May 19, 2026) now default across Gemini app, AI Mode in Search, and Gemini Enterprise. 1M context, 4x faster than other frontier models, native to Antigravity 2.0 agentic dev platform. Gemini 3.5 Pro confirmed for June 2026 GA (announced at I/O 2026, May 19): 2M-token context window, Deep Think reasoning mode, frontier multimodal; pricing expected ~$15/$60 per 1M tokens. Limited Vertex enterprise preview began in late May; Polymarket odds >70% for late-June launch. Gemini Omni 2 video editing rolled out June 16, 2026 in Pixel Drop (Android 17) — users can now chat to create and edit videos in the Gemini app, blend text/images/video, and create custom AI avatars. Lyria 3 music generation (Gemini 3 in Pixel Drop) also June 16 — text or image prompts into full tracks with custom style, vocals, and tempo on all Android 17 Pixel devices. June 17, 2026: Google Home Speaker is the first audio device built for the Gemini for Home voice assistant (pre-order $99.99, ships June 25). Gemini Live now supported on Google TV Streamer, Pixel Buds, and Pixel Watch. Pixel 10a ships with AudioLM-powered live speech-to-speech translation. AMIE research published in Nature (June 17) demonstrates primary-care-level complex disease management. Project Astra → Gemini Live improvements: continued multi-turn conversation, sub-second response, on-device visual grounding.

Amazon.name: Nova 2
Amazon.description: Amazon's Nova model family for complex reasoning, agentic workflows, and multimodal tasks. Nova 2 offers improved instruction following and lower latency via Bedrock.

OpenAI.name: GPT-5.5
OpenAI.description: Frontier reasoning model (April 23, 2026), GPT-5.5 and GPT-5.5 Pro in API (April 24). GPT-5.5 Instant default in ChatGPT since June 3, 2026. Powers Codex (including Codex Mobile preview May 14, 2026), Deep Research, voice, image, agent tools. GPT-5.6 'kindle-alpha' checkpoint surfacing in Codex logs; Polymarket prices June 30 release at 80-89%. Chief Scientist Jakub Pachocki (June 11, 2026): GPT-5.6 is a 'meaningful improvement' over GPT-5.5 with efficiency and safety upgrades; integrates coding, reasoning, and general-purpose into a single architecture ahead of the ChatGPT superapp overhaul and the confidential S-1 IPO filing (June 8, 2026). Targeted release window June 15 – July 5, 2026.

Anthropic.name: Claude Fable 5
Anthropic.description: Anthropic's first Mythos-class generally available model (June 9, 2026) at $10/$50 per 1M tokens. SOTA on SWE-Bench Pro 80.3%, FrontierCode 29.3%, OSWorld 83.4%, Humanity's Last Exam 49.8% (57.9% w/ tools). 1M context, 128K output, adaptive thinking, vision. Falls back to Opus 4.8 for cyber/biology/chemistry/distillation. Claude Mythos 5 available to Project Glasswing (expanded June 2, 2026 from ~50 to ~150 organizations across 15+ countries including power/water/healthcare/communications and Okta, Samsung, SK Hynix, SK Telecom, NATO, ENISA). SUSPENDED June 12, 2026 by US government export control directive (Commerce Department) over alleged narrow jailbreak — disabled for all customers worldwide (including foreign national Anthropic employees) pending review; Trump administration (June 15) cited Anthropic's 'recklessness' in responding to initial concerns. Free for Pro/Max/Team/Enterprise through June 22, 2026; from June 23 requires usage credits. Claude Opus 4.8 (May 28, 2026) at $5/$25 remains the default Claude surface. Legacy claude-opus-4 and claude-sonnet-4 retired June 15, 2026. Claude Security uses Opus 4.8 (released alongside) to scan codebases and suggest patches.

xAI.name: Grok 4.3
xAI.description: xAI frontier model (April 17, 2026, API May 6) with 1M context, $1.25/$2.50 per 1M tokens. grok-4.20 extends to 2M context. Custom Voices TTS ($4.20/1M chars), Voice Agent API ($3/hr). grok-imagine-image-quality for image generation. Grok 5 in training on Colossus 2 (1.5GW), Polymarket prices June 30 release at ~7%. June 17, 2026: Grok 4.3 GA on Amazon Bedrock via the new Mantle inference engine — #1 on Artificial Analysis Omniscience (lowest hallucination among frontier models), #1 on Tau2 Telecom (real-world tool-calling in customer-support agents), #1 on Vals AI Case Law and Corporate Finance benchmarks; configurable reasoning effort (none/low/medium/high), 1M context, OpenAI-compatible Responses API on Bedrock. Grok 4.20 (2M context) also available on Bedrock.

ByteDance.name: Doubao 2.0
ByteDance.description: ByteDance multimodal model family behind Doubao experiences. Seed 2.0 Pro/Lite/Mini powers Doubao App and TRAE. Seed 2.0 Lite (April 28, 2026) is first omni-modal understanding model with cross-modal audio+video reasoning. 345M MAU as of March 2026.

Oracle.name: OCI Generative AI
Oracle.description: Oracle's fully managed generative AI service for enterprise applications with REST APIs and SDKs. Summarization, writing assistance, and chat built into Oracle Cloud.

Cohere.name: Command A+
Cohere.description: Cohere's open-source 218B-parameter MoE model (May 21, 2026) with 25B active, Apache 2.0 license. Unified across reasoning, vision, translation, and tool use. Runs on 2x H100 or a single Blackwell GPU. +20% agentic QA, +32% spreadsheet analysis vs Command A Reasoning. 85% on τ²-Bench Telecom. Powers North enterprise workspace. Companion: North Mini Code (June 15, 2026) — Cohere's first dedicated open-weight agentic coding model, 30B/3B MoE, Apache 2.0.

Moonshot.name: Kimi K2.6
Moonshot.description: Moonshot's open-source agent-first model (April 20, 2026, K2.6: 1T total/32B active MoE, 256K context) optimized for coding, agent swarms, and OpenClaw/Hermes workflows. Generates full-stack sites with video hero sections and motion design from a single prompt. K2.6 Agent Swarm runs up to 300 sub-agents, 4,000 coordinated steps. K2.7-Code (June 12, 2026, 1T/32B, Modified MIT, $0.95/$4.00) is the coding-specialized variant: +21.8% on Kimi Code Bench v2 vs K2.6, 30% fewer reasoning tokens, 256K context. Powers Kimi chat, Kimi Work (local desktop), and Kimi Code. Matches/beats frontier models on coding/agentic benchmarks.

Baidu.name: ERNIE 5.1
Baidu.description: Baidu's flagship model (May 8, 2026) trained at 6% of comparable pre-training cost. 1,223 score on LMArena Search Arena (#4 global, #1 Chinese). Topped domestic search rankings; strong τ³-bench and SpreadsheetBench-Verified. Powers ernie.baidu.com chat and Qianfan model platform.

Meta.name: Muse Spark
Meta.description: Meta's latest flagship model (April 8, 2026), ranks 4th on AI Index with strong health and science reasoning. Multimodal with tool-use and Contemplating mode for multi-agent reasoning.

DeepSeek.name: DeepSeek V4
DeepSeek.description: Open-model MoE family (V4-Pro: 1.6T total / 49B active, V4-Flash: 284B / 13B active, April 24, 2026) with 1M context, Apache 2.0 licensed. 27% of per-token inference FLOPs vs V3. V4-Pro: $0.435/$0.87, V4-Flash: $0.14/$0.28 per 1M tokens (cache hit from $0.0028/$0.003625). Legacy deepseek-chat/deepseek-reasoner retire Jul 24, 2026.

Mistral.name: Medium 3.5
Mistral.description: Mistral's unified 128B dense model (April 28, 2026) replaces Medium 3.1, Magistral, and Devstral 2. 256K context, 77.6% SWE-Bench Verified, open weights under Modified MIT. Default in Le Chat and Vibe CLI (May 5, 2026).

Alibaba.name: Qwen 3.7-Max
Alibaba.description: Alibaba's new flagship model (May 26, 2026, Singapore Qwen Conference) with 1T+ parameters, 1M context, runs 35 hours autonomously without performance degradation. Top-tier on Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index. Powers Wukong enterprise platform, Qwen App with full Taobao integration, and Qwen Cloud agentic platform. Qwen3.7-Plus launched June 2, 2026 as multimodal agent model (~$0.40/$2.40 per 1M tokens, ~60% cheaper than Qwen3.7-Max), #5 globally on Vision Arena, ScreenSpot Pro 79.0 / Terminal-Bench 70.3, GUI/CLI hybrid agent, video and driving-scene understanding. Model Studio CLI (June 8, 2026) open-sources 150+ multimodal models for agent access (Qwen, HappyHorse, Wan, DeepSeek, Kimi). Qwen-powered AI swine diagnosis assistant with Muyuan Group launched June 8, 2026. Qwen-Robot Suite launched June 17, 2026 — Alibaba's first Qwen-based foundational robotics models: Qwen-RobotManip (Vision-Language-Action model for manipulation), Qwen-RobotNav (Vision-Language-Navigation for instruction following, goal navigation, target tracking, autonomous driving), Qwen-RobotWorld (video world model trained on 38,100+ hours of open-source robot data, predicts future trajectories across 20+ embodiment types and 500+ action categories). In pilot with Alibaba Cloud robotics enterprise customers; industry-leading on RoboChallenge and dozens of embodied-intelligence benchmarks.

Microsoft.name: MAI-Thinking-1
Microsoft.description: Microsoft AI's first in-house reasoning model (June 2, 2026, Build) with 35B active / ~1T total MoE params, 256K context, no third-party distillation. Matches Sonnet 4.6 in blind side-by-side, competitive with Opus 4.6 on SWE-Bench Pro coding. In private preview on Microsoft Foundry, will move to MAI Playground public preview. Also available on Fireworks AI, Baseten, Open Router.

Google.name: Gemma 4
Google.description: Google's open model family (April 2, 2026) for lightweight multimodal deployment. Gemma 4 Assistant enables speculative decoding for Gemma 4 models. Apache 2.0 license.

MiniMax.name: MiniMax M3
MiniMax.description: MiniMax's flagship open-weight model (May 31, 2026) with 1M-token context, native multimodality (image+video input, desktop computer use), and frontier coding/agentic performance. 59.0% SWE-Bench Pro, 83.5 BrowseComp, 70.06% OSWorld-Verified. Powered by MiniMax Sparse Attention (MSA) — 9x prefill, 15x decode speedup at 1M context, 1/20th per-token compute. Token Plan $20/$50/$120/mo. Open weights shipping within 10 days of release.

Nous Research.name: Hermes 3
Nous Research.description: Nous Research's open-weight instruction-tuned model series, evolving into the Hermes Agent (189K GitHub stars, MIT, v0.16.0 'The Surface Release' June 6, 2026). 40+ tools, MCP integration, persistent memory, scheduled tasks, messaging gateway across Telegram/Discord/Slack/WhatsApp/Signal. Optimized for local agentic workflows on NVIDIA RTX PCs and DGX Spark with Qwen 3.6, Llama, Mistral via Ollama or LM Studio.

NVIDIA.name: Nemotron 3 Ultra
NVIDIA.description: NVIDIA's 550B total / 55B active LatentMoE (Mamba-2 + MoE + Attention hybrid) with Multi-Token Prediction, released June 4, 2026 under OpenMDW-1.1. 1M context, NVFP4 quantization runs on Hopper/Blackwell/Ampere, 5x faster inference vs other open models, 30% lower cost to task completion on Terminal Bench 2. 20T pretraining tokens. Packaged as NIM microservice with OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible APIs.

Z.ai.name: GLM 5.2
Z.ai.description: Z.ai's flagship open-weight model (announced June 13, 2026 on Coding Plan; full launch June 16, 2026, the day after Fable 5 was suspended). 744B total / ~40B active MoE (384 experts), 1M-token solid lossless context, 128K max output, 28.5T pretraining tokens. New IndexShare architecture reuses the indexer across every 4 sparse-attention layers — 2.9x per-token FLOPs reduction at 1M context; improved MTP layer for speculative decoding boosts acceptance length up to 20%. Strongest open-source long-horizon coding agent: trails Opus 4.8 by 1% on FrontierSWE, beats GPT-5.5 and Opus 4.7 on multiple agentic benchmarks, highest-ranked open model on Terminal-Bench 2.1 (81.0 vs Opus 85.0) and SWE-bench Pro (62.1). Beats GLM-5.1 by +19 on Terminal-Bench 2.1 and +3.7 on SWE-bench Pro. Pure MIT license — no regional limits, positioned by Z.ai as 'frontier intelligence belongs to everyone.' First shipped to GLM Coding Plan subscribers (June 13); full open-weight release on Hugging Face under zai-org (mid-June 2026). Z.ai (formerly Zhipu AI, HKEX:02513, IPO January 2026, +820% since listing) positions GLM-5.2 as the open-model beneficiary of Anthropic's Fable 5 export suspension.

Cohere.name: North Mini Code
Cohere.description: Cohere's first open-weight agentic coding model (June 15, 2026, Apache 2.0 from launch). 30B-parameter MoE with 3B active parameters, designed for multi-step tool-using work in agents like Claude Code and Cursor. Companion to the closed-weight Command A+ enterprise family. Frames the developer-tooling sovereignty gap the same way Cohere framed enterprise AI sovereignty — who controls the coding agent controls how engineering evolves.

Google.name: Gemini Spark
Google.description: 24/7 personal AI agent powered by Gemini 3.5 Flash (May 19, 2026). Now with Notebooks for project organization, sync with NotebookLM. Deep Think and Deep Research Max modes available. Project Mariner capabilities folded into Gemini Agent. MacOS app integration announced for summer 2026. June 16, 2026 Pixel Drop / Android 17: Gemini Omni 2 video creation/editing in the Gemini app on Pixel (blend text, images, video into finished clips, build custom AI avatars); Lyria 3 music generation on all Android 17 Pixel devices (text or image prompts into tracks with custom style/vocals/tempo). June 17, 2026: Google Home Speaker ($99.99, shipping June 25, pre-orders open) is the first device built for the Gemini for Home voice assistant — natural multi-step conversations, Gemini Live ('Hey Google, let's chat'), Continued Conversation in all supported languages, 10 new voices, and Camera History Search for Nest cams. Google Home Premium ($10/mo or $100/yr) unlocks Gemini Live on the speaker, AI-powered camera history search, and Google Home Brief; free for 6 months with Home Speaker purchased before mid-September. Wear OS 7 launches same day with Personal Intelligence features (custom widgets by description, connected Google apps/chat history). Pixel 10a gains speech-to-speech translation with AudioLM. AMIE medical-AI research published in Nature (June 17, 2026) — conversational system matches primary-care physicians on complex disease management.

OpenAI.name: ChatGPT
OpenAI.description: Powered by GPT-5.5 with GPT-5.5 Instant as default since June 3, 2026 (readability upgrade May 28). Personal Finance experience (May 15) for Pro users with Plaid. ChatGPT for Excel and Google Sheets GA (May 5). Voice intelligence updates May 7 with GPT-Realtime-2, GPT-Realtime-Translate, GPT-Realtime-Whisper. Codex Mobile interface in ChatGPT iOS/Android (May 14, 2026) with worktrees, Codex profile screen, /goal support, inline review comments. OpenAI Partner Network launched June 14, 2026 with $150M program and three tiers (Select/Advanced/Elite) targeting 300,000 certified consultants by end of 2026 — Forward Deployed Experts pilot for complex enterprise deployments. Pinned Chats and revamped Projects rolled out across web/Android/iOS on June 15, 2026 — pin important conversations to the top of the sidebar, group related chats and files into per-project workspaces with per-project custom instructions. o3 Pro Mode launched in ChatGPT Pro on June 16, 2026 (gated behind $200/mo Pro tier) — o3 with extended thinking time for higher-capability reasoning on graduate-level math, competitive programming, and scientific reasoning. Visa-OpenAI payment integration announced June 15, 2026 to embed secure global payments directly inside ChatGPT for agentic shopping. ChatGPT Superapp overhaul (coding tools, agents, third-party Canva/Booking.com integrations) planned for rollout over coming weeks ahead of confidential IPO filing. June 17, 2026: Scheduled Tasks feature (replaces Pulse in 14 days) lets users schedule reminders, recurring work, and monitoring tasks at hourly intervals or named windows (morning/afternoon/evening); new Scheduled page in sidebar surfaces active tasks, next-run times, pause/resume/edit/delete controls; rolling out to Go, Plus, Pro, Business, and Enterprise on web and mobile. Codex Europe/UK/Switzerland expansion June 17, 2026 — Computer Use, Chrome Extension, Memories (opt-in for EEA/UK/CH due to regional privacy), and Chronicle (macOS opt-in research preview that reads recent screen context to build more relevant Codex memories) now available in those regions. June 18, 2026: GPT-5.5 Instant health intelligence upgrade — matches Thinking-tier models on HealthBench Professional (230M+ people use ChatGPT weekly for health); 71% drop in incorrect health statements over 2 months; physician-evaluated improvements across 26 medical specialties, 60 countries, 49 languages; ChatGPT for Clinicians and OpenAI for Healthcare offer specialized tools. New usage analytics and updated spend controls for enterprises (June 18, 2026).

Anthropic.name: Claude
Anthropic.description: Default on Sonnet 4.6, Opus 4.8 for max capability. Claude Fable 5 (Mythos-class) SUSPENDED June 12, 2026 by US export control directive — disabled for all customers. Free for Pro/Max/Team/Enterprise through June 22, then metered credits from June 23. Claude for Small Business (May 13) with Quickbooks, PayPal, HubSpot, Canva, Docusign connectors. Claude Cowork GA (April 9) on macOS/Windows. Microsoft 365 add-ins for Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Outlook. Effort control across all plans. Anthropic-DXC alliance (June 11, 2026) and TCS partnership (June 12, 2026) for regulated industries. June 15, 2026: Agent SDK / claude -p / GitHub Actions usage moves from subscription limits to a separate monthly credit ($20 Pro, $100 Max 5x, $200 Max 20x, one-time claim, no rollover); legacy claude-opus-4 and claude-sonnet-4 retire. June 16, 2026: Multilingual voice mode upgrade rolling out across iOS/Android with 18 new languages (German, Portuguese, Chinese, Japanese, Russian, Ukrainian, more), real-time mid-conversation language switching, push-to-talk, and redesigned phone-call icon. Workspace agents (April 22) available in research preview in ChatGPT Business/Enterprise/Edu/Teachers plans with credit-based pricing from May 6, 2026. June 17, 2026: Seoul office opens under KiYoung Choi; MOU with Korea's Ministry of Science and ICT on AI safety and cybersecurity, evaluating model safety in Korean with the Korea AI Safety Institute. Claude Design major overhaul (June 17) — design system imports from GitHub repos, design files, or raw uploads; new admin role can approve a system and lock edits; /design-sync command in Claude Code imports the local codebase's design system into Claude Design; /design command in Claude Code creates/edits/syncs design projects without leaving the terminal; bidirectional Claude Design ↔ Claude Code hand-off; token-efficient rewrite doubles weekly token limits across all subscription tiers (originally announced May 19); more than 1M users in Claude Design's first week. June 17: First AI startup to join the Frontier carbon removal coalition ($915M funding tranche). June 17: Anthropic staff head to Washington to negotiate lifting Fable 5 export ban (Commerce Secretary Lutnick, Cyber Director Cairncross in talks since June 13).

Microsoft.name: Copilot
Microsoft.description: Powered by GPT-5.5 Instant (May 7, 2026) across web, work, and Microsoft 365 surfaces. Agent Platform, Agents SDK, and Copilot Studio for enterprise orchestration. MAI-Thinking-1 (June 2, 2026) available in private preview for in-house reasoning. Opus 4.8 and Fable 5 in GitHub Copilot. Microsoft Scout (June 2, 2026, Frontier preview) is the first Autopilot — always-on personal agent integrated into Teams/Outlook/OneDrive, built on OpenClaw. New Copilot superapp launch. June 16, 2026: Copilot Cowork GA worldwide with usage-based pricing (1 cent per Copilot Credit, or P3 tier with volume discount) on top of the M365 Copilot license ($30/mo enterprise / $20/mo Business). Cowork runs in Microsoft's cloud, not on user devices — acts on docs inside the customer's M365 tenant. Admins can enable Cowork, set per-tenant/group/user spending limits, and receive spend alerts. Model options in Cowork: Anthropic Opus 4.8, Sonnet 4.6, Frontier program users get GPT-5.5 plus Microsoft's own Cowork 1 model; Microsoft reportedly planning a hosted DeepSeek option to lower costs. June 16: Microsoft IQ generally available across GitHub Copilot, Foundry, Copilot Studio (Work IQ GA APIs for agents) — new context layer grounds agents in world knowledge + enterprise knowledge; Agent 365 control plane for observing/governing/managing/securing agents. GitHub Copilot app in technical preview (June 8) for desktop agent-native workflows.

Meta.name: Meta AI
Meta.description: Powered by Muse Spark. Meta AI app rebuilt natively on May 12, 2026: Contemplating mode (multi-agent visible parallel reasoning), Live AI camera for real-time vision streaming, Marketplace shopping agent across WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook. Free at meta.ai and across Meta apps, Instagram, Facebook, Messenger, WhatsApp. Rolling out to Ray-Ban Meta glasses. Meta Business Agent (June 3, 2026) is the customer-facing business AI deployed on WhatsApp, Messenger, and Instagram (1M+ businesses, 1B+ daily threads) with morning briefings. Meta Business Agent Platform provides enterprise-scale agent building, customization, and deployment with Shopify/Zendesk/Shopee connectors. Meta Creator Assistant (June 14, 2026) is the conversational AI inside Facebook creator dashboards that explains audience data, content performance, and engagement patterns in plain language (US, Canada, India). Meta One Plus ($7.99) and Meta One Premium ($19.99) AI plans launched May 27, 2026 in Singapore, Guatemala, Bolivia. Facebook AI Mode launched June 15, 2026 — new search tab on Facebook that uses Meta AI to surface conversational answers pulled from public posts across Groups, Reels, and Marketplace (US first). Meta Edits App desktop version and AI Production Assistant launched June 15, 2026 at LA creator event — desktop video editor with AI assistant for content ideas and analytics-based guidance, integrates with Adobe Premiere / DaVinci Resolve workflows.

Amazon.name: Amazon Q
Amazon.description: Enterprise-first assistant grounded in AWS services and company data. Two tiers: Q Business for knowledge work, Q Developer for coding. Alexa for Shopping (May 13, 2026) replaces Rufus, integrates shopping capabilities into main Alexa experience.

xAI.name: Grok
xAI.description: Powered by Grok 4.3 with Connectors for web, iOS, Android. MCP server support. Custom Voices (Apr 30, 2026), $4.20 per 1M characters for TTS. Grok Skills (May 22, 2026) for persistent custom expertise, file/deck/spreadsheet/PDF generation. Grok Build early beta for SuperGrok Heavy subscribers (May 14, 2026). Grok Business and Enterprise tiers. Grok Build Plugin Marketplace (June 11, 2026) with skills/MCP/plugins from MongoDB, Vercel, Sentry, Chrome DevTools, Cloudflare, Superpowers. Gopuff Go agent (June 9, 2026) powered by Grok text/audio/image. eToro Tori (June 10, 2026) with real-time market sentiment from X. Grok Voice API default for Vapi (June 3, 2026). June 15, 2026: Grok Build gains multi-session manager — manage many coding sessions at once, see what each is doing, reply to ones that need you, and dispatch new work. Grok V9-Medium (1.5T params, Cursor-trained coding model) finished training May 25 with public release expected mid-June 2026 (Polymarket ~30% odds of Grok 5 by June 30, 2026; Grok 5 still training on Colossus 2 1.5GW). June 16, 2026: Grok for PowerPoint launched — generate full slide decks directly in PowerPoint from a Grok prompt. June 17, 2026: Grok 4.3 GA on Amazon Bedrock — see Foundation Models entry for benchmarks and pricing. Agent Dashboard in Grok Build (June 15) gives a unified view of running agents across cloud/local. Grok for Word add-in launched June 18, 2026 — free Microsoft 365 add-in turns notes into structured documents, fixes grammar, brings research from web/X/connectors (SharePoint, Google Drive) directly into Word. Also available for PowerPoint and Excel.

DeepSeek.name: DeepSeek Chat
DeepSeek.description: Powered by DeepSeek V4 with multimodal image recognition (April 29, 2026). Expert Mode (Pro) and Instant Mode (Flash) available. Optimized for Claude Code and OpenClaw. Legacy deepseek-chat/deepseek-reasoner retire Jul 24, 2026. Native image understanding launched June 18, 2026 (DeepSeek AI Assistant v2.1.8) — describe/interpret/answer questions about images directly in chat, available to free and paid users. Recognizes objects, landmarks, can solve math problems from images; person identification remains inconsistent.

Mistral.name: Vibe
Mistral.description: Mistral's unified AI agent (rebranded from Le Chat, May 28, 2026) with Work Mode (long-running multi-step tasks with parallel tool calls, recurring scheduled jobs, 100+ connectors, MCP) and Code Mode (remote cloud coding sessions in isolated sandboxes, GitHub PR integration, Slack trigger). New VS Code extension and JetBrains/Zed ACP integration. Powered by Mistral Medium 3.5. Pro $14.99/mo, Team $24.99/user/mo. 20+ MCP-powered connectors added June 18, 2026 (Databricks, Snowflake, GitHub, Stripe, Asana) with one-click memory import from ChatGPT; available on free plan. Vibe (formerly Le Chat) consolidates Work Mode, Code Mode, and Chat Mode.

ByteDance.name: Doubao
ByteDance.description: Powered by Doubao 2.0 and Seed 2.0. 345M MAU (March 2026). Paid subscriptions launched May 4: Standard 68 yuan, Advanced 200 yuan, Professional 500 yuan.

Tencent.name: Yuanbao
Tencent.description: Powered by Hunyuan 3.0 (Hy3) MoE, 295B total params, 21B active, 256K context — fast-and-slow thinking fused. 9 legacy models (HY 2.0 Think, hunyuan-T1-latest, hunyuan-turbos, hunyuan-standard, hunyuan-role, etc.) retire June 26, 2026; multimodal vision models (HY Vision 1.5 Instruct, hunyuan-turbos-vision, hunyuan-t1-vision, hunyuan-turbos-vision-video) retire June 22, 2026. New multimodal lineup: HY-Vision-2.0-Instruct, HY-Vision-1.5-Thinking, HY-Vision-Video, YT-VITA on TokenHub. HunyuanVideo-Avatar open-sourced for voice-driven digital humans (May 28, 2026). API on TokenHub at $0.18/M input, $0.59/M output.

Alibaba.name: Qwen Chat
Alibaba.description: Powered by Qwen 3.7-Max (May 26, 2026) with 35-hour autonomous runs, multilingual chat, agentic coding, and advanced reasoning. Full Taobao integration (4B+ products) for agentic shopping. Shopping assistant with AI try-on. Compatible with Qoder coding platform.

HuggingFace.name: HuggingChat
HuggingFace.description: Multi-model open chat surface for Llama, Qwen, Mistral, and more. Inference API 3.0 with edge deployment, 10x latency improvements, offline inference.

Perplexity.name: Perplexity
Perplexity.description: Answer engine with GPT-5.5 orchestration. Personal Computer for Mac (May 11). Computer Agent with Workflows, Teams integration, Snowflake/Databricks connectors. Computer in Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook (May 28, 2026); Teams integration from earlier in May. Harvard Business School study (June 10, 2026): Computer cuts estimated task time by 87% and cost by 94% across 10,000 matched pairs. Personal Computer with local inference (hybrid local-server orchestrator) coming in July 2026 — first product to treat compute as one more thing to orchestrate across machine and cloud. Brain (June 18, 2026, Research Preview, Max + Enterprise Max) — self-improving work-memory system that builds a context graph of Computer sessions, teaches itself overnight how to do recurring work better, shows its sources, and improves answer correctness +25% / recall +16% / cost -13% on repeated tasks.

MiniMax.name: MiniMax Agent
MiniMax.description: MiniMax's AI assistant powered by MiniMax M3 (June 1, 2026) with Agent Team building, MSA-powered 1M-context reasoning, habit learning, and all-in-one chat with skills, memories, and schedules. Desktop app available. Token Plan tiers $20/$50/$120/mo.

Cohere.name: Coral
Cohere.description: Cohere's enterprise chat assistant (May 2026) powered by Command A+. North workspace integration for grounded answers over enterprise data. Multi-session memory and agentic tool use. Free and Pro tiers.

Moonshot.name: Kimi
Moonshot.description: Moonshot's flagship AI assistant (May 2026) powered by Kimi K2.6 with K2.6 Agent Swarm (up to 300 sub-agents, 4,000 coordinated steps) and Kimi Claw cloud teammate. Long-context chat, web search, multimodal inputs, deep research, agent swarm workflows. Kimi Work (June 8/12 2026) is the local-first desktop variant — see Sovereign Agent. Free, Moderato $19/mo, Allegretto $39/mo, Allegro $99/mo.

Apple.name: Siri AI
Apple.description: Apple's Siri AI assistant, unveiled at WWDC26 (June 1, 2026) as an entirely new version of Siri powered by next-generation Apple Foundation Models. Profoundly more capable and conversational, with personal context understanding, onscreen awareness, broad world knowledge, Visual Intelligence, and a dedicated Siri app to revisit conversations (iCloud-synced). New architecture routes between on-device models and Private Cloud Compute; the Foundation Models framework gives any app direct access to the on-device models powering Apple Intelligence. iOS 27 / iPadOS 27 / macOS 27 / watchOS 27 / visionOS 27 / tvOS 27; available for developer testing today, beta later this year, English first, free software update this fall. Supported on iPhone 16+ and 15 Pro/Pro Max, iPad mini (A17 Pro) and M1+ iPads, MacBook Neo (A18 Pro) and M1+ Macs, Apple Vision Pro, Apple Watch Series 9+/Ultra 2+/SE 3 (paired with AI-enabled iPhone). The Image Playground API also gains a powerful new generative model on Private Cloud Compute with photorealistic output and refinement via natural language.

Google.name: Gemini Code Assist
Google.description: IDE coding agent powered by Gemini 3.5 Flash, native to Android Studio, VS Code, JetBrains. Antigravity 2.0 released May 19, 2026 as agent-first dev platform with parallel sub-agents.

OpenAI.name: Codex

Plans, orchestrates, and improves CX processes grounded in enterprise data, workflows, and brand controls. Anchored in Adobe Real-Time CDP, Journey Optimizer, Customer Journey Analytics, Marketo Engage, Target. Built on MCP and A2A open standards. AI Assistant (powered by Adobe creative agent) is now in public beta across Premiere, Photoshop, Illustrator, Frame.io, and InDesign since June 18, 2026 — orchestrates multi-step workflows via conversational prompts inside the apps people already use.

Salesforce.name: Agentforce
Salesforce.description: Salesforce's enterprise agent platform. Agentforce 1 Editions with 12,000+ ARR as of Q4 FY26, $800M ARR (+169% YoY) heading into Q1 FY27 earnings May 27, 2026. Headless 360 architecture (April 2026 TDX) exposes every Salesforce capability as API, MCP tool, or CLI. Operations released May 3 with 30+ back-office blueprints. Summer '26 release GA on June 15, 2026 (API v67.0): Multi-Agent Orchestration graduates from beta to GA (Atlas Reasoning Engine 3.0, one orchestrator routes dynamically across registered subagents), Agentforce Self-Service (Help Agent setup in 6 clicks, Portal experience, simplified pricing), Customer Engagement Agent (24/7 lead capture with warm handoff to sales), Momentum (auto-captures calls/emails/meetings back to Salesforce for agentic selling), Scheduling Console (AI-powered dispatch with map routes), Tableau MCP and Salesforce-hosted MCP servers GA. Setup with Agentforce now GA (May 2026) for admins; legacy agent upgrade to new Agentforce Builder; OpenAI Search provider GA for Bring Your Own Channel.

Apple.name: Apple Intelligence for Enterprise
Apple.description: Apple's enterprise surface for Apple Intelligence, announced at WWDC26 (June 1, 2026): Apple Intelligence and Siri AI ship as free software updates in iOS 27 / iPadOS 27 / macOS 27 / watchOS 27 / visionOS 27 / tvOS 27 this fall. Built on Apple silicon with on-device processing and Private Cloud Compute for larger server-based models (personal data not stored or made accessible to Apple). Foundation Models framework lets enterprise developers integrate Apple Intelligence into their apps at no per-request cost. App Intents framework connects line-of-business apps to Siri AI. Trust and safety improvements: stronger parental controls, Communication Safety, expanded Sensitive Content Warning. iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Watch, Apple Vision Pro.

Moonshot.name: Kimi Work
Moonshot.description: Moonshot's local-first desktop AI agent (announced June 8, 2026, opened for testing June 12, 2026) for macOS (Apple Silicon) and Windows. Runs on Kimi K2.6 with up to 300 parallel sub-agents and 4,000 coordinated steps. WebBridge drives the user's real logged-in browser; built-in cron engine runs scheduled tasks; mounts local folders and runs Python. Produces documents, spreadsheets, PDFs, slide decks, and renders full websites with live preview. Free download; Moderato $19/mo, Allegretto $39/mo (full 300-agent swarm), Allegro $99/mo for highest-volume professional use.

Apple.name: App Intents Agent
Apple.description: Apple's on-device agent surface unveiled at WWDC26 (June 1, 2026) via the App Intents framework. Adopting App Intents schemas lets any app's content and capabilities become discoverable and executable through natural language inside Siri AI, Shortcuts, and Spotlight. The new View Annotations API maps on-screen views to entities so users can reference and act on what's in front of them conversationally. The new App Intents Testing framework validates the full integration (Siri, Shortcuts, Spotlight) through real system pathways without UI automation. All processing stays on device with the Foundation Models framework; Personal Context and App Toolbox are first-party Apple Intelligence components.
